data.one_liner: Flutter plugin for RevenueCat in‑app purchases and subscriptions across iOS, Android, web and macOS.
data.what_it_does: Wraps StoreKit, Google Play Billing and the RevenueCat backend to simplify in‑app purchase flows. Handles receipt validation, subscription status tracking and provides analytics integration.
use_when: You need cross‑platform in‑app purchases/subscriptions with server‑side receipt validation
You are already using or plan to use RevenueCat as your billing backend
You want a single API for iOS, Android, web and macOS
avoid_when: You prefer a custom billing solution without a third‑party service
Your app does not require purchases or subscriptions
strengths: Built‑in receipt validation and subscription status tracking
Frequent releases and good support from RevenueCat
weaknesses: Locks you into the RevenueCat service
Adds external dependency and potential app size increase
Limited to features exposed by RevenueCat
data.setup_notes: Add purchases_flutter to pubspec, configure RevenueCat API keys for each platform, ensure native setup (Xcode, Gradle) and required permissions (e.g., billing), optional web configuration.
